lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7-8 high-contrast vertical lines visible; spacing increases significantly towards the posterior haunch compared to the anterior cluster.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: First two anterior lines and the final posterior line terminate approximately mid-torso, failing to reach the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster of 5 visible white spots located on the lower posterior haunch above the stifle.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Spiral-lyrate curvature with terminal tips oriented vertically; primary divergence angle from skull base is approximately 40 degrees.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The terminal tip-to-tip span is approximately 2.3 times the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately the upper 12-15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Dual high-contrast white facial spots on the lower cheek; distinct white chevron present between the orbital regions; prominent white dorsal and ventral fringe.
